__inputs.name: DS_VICTORIALOGS
__inputs.label: VictoriaLogs
__inputs.description: Used only for the emitters table (emails are not in metrics)

description: Lotus user-perceived journeys from VictoriaMetrics: startup, activity → chat, chat skeleton, notification open, and active sessions. Extend this file when adding more journey panels. Emails stay on VictoriaLogs.

targets.expr: count by (os_type) (sum by (session_id, os_type) (increase(app_session_heartbeat_total{service_name="xynespaces-native", os_type=~"$os_type", service_version=~"$service_version"}[2m])) > 0)

panels.title: Active sessions
panels.description: Foreground sessions with a heartbeat in the last 2 minutes.

targets.expr: sum by (os_type)(increase(app_startup_duration_milliseconds_count{service_name="xynespaces-native", os_type=~"$os_type", service_version=~"$service_version", launch_cause=~"$launch_cause", destination=~"$destination"}[$__range]))

sum by (os_type)(increase(activity_message_highlight_duration_milliseconds_count{service_name="xynespaces-native", os_type=~"$os_type", service_version=~"$service_version", surface=~"$surface"}[$__range]))

sum by (os_type)(increase(chat_open_skeleton_duration_milliseconds_count{service_name="xynespaces-native", os_type=~"$os_type", service_version=~"$service_version", entry=~"$entry", surface=~"$surface"}[$__range]))

sum by (os_type)(increase(notification_message_highlight_duration_milliseconds_count{service_name="xynespaces-native", os_type=~"$os_type", service_version=~"$service_version", app_state=~"$app_state", surface=~"$surface"}[$__range]))
count by (os_type) (sum by (session_id, os_type) (increase(app_session_heartbeat_total{service_name="xynespaces-native", os_type=~"$os_type", service_version=~"$service_version"}[2m])) > 0)

histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, os_type) (increase(activity_message_highlight_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_name="xynespaces-native", os_type=~"$os_type", service_version=~"$service_version", surface=~"$surface"}[$__range])))
